preconditions: User authorized G-06 closure in the previously selected isolated synthetic scope.
G-05 automated qualification and exact predecessor digest verified.
Fixed authenticated Qwen artifact and constrained worker profile verified.

normal_steps.expected: Actor-only and assisted runs permit durable manual follow-through; assistance remains attributable and unsent.
normal_steps.actual: Live matched case passed with one scoped protocol observation, exact review edit and worker rejection.

normal_steps.action: Real provider and deployed role trust
normal_steps.expected: Loaded model, tokenizer and authenticated boundaries remain exact.
normal_steps.actual: Live Qwen and protected SPIRE/Envoy provider edge passed. Separate deployed role graph and revocation passed.

adverse_steps.action: Timeout while actual challenge remains pending
adverse_steps.expected: Keep exact unknown slot occupied, avoid draft, preserve manual service.
adverse_steps.actual: All verified on the same real request and durable TLS database. The observation never entered broker custody.

adverse_steps.action: Stale review, replay and unauthorized route
adverse_steps.expected: Reject stale and forged operations, preserve shared budgets and manual fallback.
adverse_steps.actual: Exact stale review digest rejected. Durable, role and browser checks passed.

checks.name: matched-actor-workflow
checks.expected: Matched actor-only and live assisted case, bounded tool, exact review and manual follow-through.
checks.actual: Both cases committed a human-authored reply. Assisted worker edited and rejected one durable extracted draft. No referral dispatch.

checks.name: live-timeout-containment
checks.command: pytest tests/evaluation/qwen_g06_timeout.py using the live provider
checks.expected: Real provider response still pending after caller timeout, exact durable unknown slot, usable manual write and no late proposal.
checks.actual: Manual write committed at 0.3223s while Qwen request was pending. Same response completed at 7.5215s. Job and slot stayed compute_unknown and no draft was emitted.

checks.name: budgets-and-adverse-database
checks.command: pytest on dedicated verify-full manifest-pinned PostgreSQL
checks.expected: Durable claims, restart budgets, authority and source fencing, stop evidence policies.
checks.actual: 40 passed. Deterministic matched fixture also passed.

checks.name: isolated-role-network
checks.expected: Six authenticated edges, no direct bypass, SVID rotation and live revocation with manual availability.
checks.actual: Previously ran on exact unchanged candidate. Six allowed edges, four denied probes, restrictive generation and manual response passed.

checks.name: protected-live-provider
checks.expected: Live tokenizer and generation through verified Inference identity plus malformed route denials.
checks.actual: Pinned SPIRE and Envoy passed. Real Qwen exact count was 27 input tokens. Both malformed requests were denied after cold startup readiness correction.

checks.name: browser-bilingual
checks.expected: Real Chromium EN/FR keyboard, axe, reflow, stale review, permissions and manual fallback.

checks.name: exact-model-function
checks.expected: Exact signed candidate model/render/tokenizer, EN/FR verified grounding and injected context.
checks.actual: Four authenticated EN/FR cases passed with exact counts and zero reasoning tokens against unchanged model sources.

checks.name: bounded-model-load
checks.expected: Admitted input cap qualified under bounded concurrency.
checks.actual: Ten live cases passed at up to 2035 prompt tokens below the 2048 limit. Sample p95 23.261 seconds.

checks.name: pinned-threat-mapping
checks.command: Compare upstream pin SHA-256, profile applicability and exact evidence links
checks.expected: Verify OWASP and ATLAS identifiers bound to worker profile cases.
checks.actual: Eight pinned files and nine identifiers verified.

checks.name: source-contract-lock
checks.command: Scoped pytest, Pyright, Ruff, contract checks, lock and dependency boundaries
checks.expected: Current source and contract regressions pass.
checks.actual: 148 scoped tests plus all static checks passed.

residuals: Scope is isolated synthetic worker_summary only. Other model functions remain disabled.
Independent signed exact serving approval and current evaluator boots govern existing demo activation.
Separate operator-controlled provider restart has its own lifecycle qualification scope. This gate exercised live timeout containment and preserves uncertain occupancy.
Human usability, native assistive-technology, visual, language and clinical review remain deferred_until_after_IMP10.
acceptance_scope: Automated qualification for IMP-06 isolated synthetic worker_summary / prepare_summary / draft_ready and applicable VT-08, VT-09, VT-18 and AT-08, AT-17, AT-18 outcomes.
rollback: Advance restrictive release epoch, preserve manual service and held compute until observed completion or verified stop.
